Grand Hanoi Hotel Quốc Oai Khu Dat Dau Gia Ceo - Quoc Oai - Ha Noi, Hanoi, Vietnam Map Hanoi > 3 stars > Hotels > Grand Hanoi Hotel Quoc Oai View all photos Grand Hanoi Hotel Quoc Oai Featuring currency exchange and a lift, Grand Hanoi Hotel Quoc Oai is situated 15 minutes' stroll from the Thay Temple. This comfortable hotel offers 9 rooms with views of the city. The hotel has a prime location in proximity to the Buddhist temple "Thay Pagoda". The property is also just 1.5 km from Baara Land. This 3-star hotel is also a short way from West Lake. Sunny Garden City bus stop is located nearby, a few steps from the Grand Hanoi Hotel Quoc Oai. The air-conditioned rooms offer a seating area, along with sound-proofed windows for guests' comfort. Along with a mini-fridge-bar, coffee and tea making facilities, the rooms are furnished with a writing table. Air-conditioned bedrooms have beds with plump-down pillows as well as electric blankets.
